C-7: section 8 records ruling ids (SEC-518-R1, SEC-518-R2-modules, SEC-518-R2-help), threading fallback removed, 7.5 PR checklist, config/test.exs :modules trigger. Snapshot arithmetic 0 + 6 + 15 + 7 = 28 with M2/H1 now :self_service. Two defects fixed directly (below); one affects 2c-i-a.

findings.problem: R-1 makes the :exam_route_reclassified walk rule mandatory in 2c-i-a (the literal :all at exam sites 7-9 is built there and the ruling lapses without the guard), but 3.1 and section 1 said 2c-i-a changes no route walk, the rule was missing from the 3.6 walk-error list and had no test id. ELIXIR-DEV could have shipped the literals without the guard.
findings.fix: 3.1 and the section 1 row now say the ONE additive walk rule shipping in 2c-i-a is :exam_route_reclassified (route_scope.ex and its walk test; no class, snapshot or expectation-list change); added to the 3.6 error list; new test T-C15 (walk rule over ANY exam entry-module route plus the scan for an exam manifest gaining :scope_declarations while the SEC-518-R1 literal remains). Note route_scope.ex is therefore a SEC trigger file for 2c-i-a as well (7.5 item 2 already lists it).

findings.problem: C-3 requires the pure new-value check before Idempotency.from_body for create AND update, but the create paragraph still said the new value is checked only in the :scope_check step.
findings.fix: Create paragraph now states ScopedWrites.check_new_value/3 runs right after envelope validation and before Idempotency.from_body, with :scope_check as race backstop.

findings.problem: The ScopeSetError to detail-free 500 mapping relies on the existing pipeline error handler for exceptions raised in a handler; ELIXIR-DEV should assert it through HTTP (T-C13 already says 'through HTTP the response is the detail-free 500') rather than assume it.
